verdict.rationale: Browserbase ships a first-party Browserbase Agent. You create it in the dashboard by describing a goal in natural language, run it on demand or on a schedule, and it can pause to ask you for input before continuing. The dashboard's Optimize tool also helps refine the agent's prompt or turn a completed run into a reusable script. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the built-in agent, and detail on the in-product assistant experience beyond brief doc snippets.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Create your Browserbase Agent from the dashboard by describing the goal in natural language.
Deploy and run browser agents on Browserbase, on a schedule or on demand.
With `pauseWhen`, the Agent can pause the run, tell you what it needs, and continue exactly where it left off once you reply.
The Optimize tool lives in the Agent run view in the dashboard
